description: The canonical topic taxonomy with per-topic bill counts (GET /v1/topics). Call this first to find the right slug for the topic filter on search_bills, instead of guessing one. Pass a slug to get that topic's detail and a sample of the raw subject names folded into it (GET /v1/topics/{slug}); to get the topic's actual bills, use search_bills with topic=<slug>.

slug.description: Optional topic slug, e.g. 'healthcare'. Omit to list the whole taxonomy.

name: list_topics
title: List topics
